purpose: Recover the producer and mutation order needed to extend default materials to reference graphs without inventing model semantics.

entry.common_prefix: Exact signed material selector and find-or-create including refresh happen before this case, as for MTNAME.

storage.mode: signed int32 at material+0x1cc8; selected producer uses1, clear uses0, finalizer assigns2 to resolved targets.
storage.logical_count: signed int32 at+0x1ccc, written directly by integer line helper, may be zero or negative.
storage.allocation: int32 buffer at+0x1cd0; logical count and retained allocation MUST be represented separately.
storage.reason: Successful nonpositive count imports can retain an old nonnull buffer. Count-helper failure zeros count but returns before changing mode or allocation.

positive_count: Save previous count before calling413de0(FILE,&count,0). Any nonzero helper status returns2 after its direct count mutation.
For count>0, set mode1, free any previous nonnull allocation, null pointer, calloc(count,4), then scan references in order.
Each reference uses stream %Flf into the same uninitialized local double; only return-1 is tested. Successful conversion is truncated toward zero with CVTTSD2SI to int32.
On EOF return2 without undoing mode/count/allocation or already-written IDs. Unwritten calloc entries remain zero.
No terminal fgets or component refresh occurs at the end of this case. The shared tail maps nonzero helper status to2.
nonpositive_count: Only if mode==1 AND old pointer nonnull AND saved previous count>0, visit exactly the saved previous count IDs from retained storage.
Resolve each old ID by exact material lookup; if found, write target mode0, regardless of its previous mode.
After the loop, write source mode0. Do not free/null the old reference allocation and do not replace its contents.
If the guard fails, leave mode and old allocation as they were. Retain the helper-written zero/negative logical count.

count_reader.behavior: Zero destination before one fgets1024. Replace commas with spaces; sscanf %i. Null fgets or scan-1 returns1, while matching failure0 returns0 with destination zero. skipblank argument is0 here.

finalization.order: Visit material insertion positions1..root1320. For each current mode1 source, re-read its current logical count at every loop test.
finalization.target_mutation: For each resolved target whose mode!=2: if target count>0, free its nonnull reference pointer, null it, set count0; then set mode2. For count<=0, retain target allocation/count and set mode2.
finalization.aliasing: Mutations are immediate and order-dependent. A self-reference can clear the source count and end its own loop. A preceding source can change a later source to mode2 before it is visited.
finalization.not_equivalent_to: A graph reachability traversal, topological pass, or snapshot-based batch update.

layout_dependency: 1d64f0 queries49..52 return true when root85c!=0 or any material has mode1. This invalidates the current immutable default-name-only feature assumptions. Recover actual refresh timing rather than refreshing eagerly after MSTMTR.
next_validation: Positive references to existing and missing IDs, duplicate references, fractional finite IDs truncating to signed32.
Zero and negative counts after populated reference allocation; observe allocation extent separately from logical count.
Blank/EOF count helper versus matching-failure count, and EOF at each reference position.
Self-reference, cycles, chains and insertion-order reversals with intermediate handler and finalization snapshots.
A subsequent material append or configuration refresh after reference-mode changes, then populated-object remapping.
limits: Static REA evidence only; no claim that current C++ implements this contract.
Reference matching failure can use uninitialized/prior local double; do not invent a zero value. Numeric overflow/nonfinite conversion and allocation failure need separate evidence.
Native scientific meaning of modes0/1/2 is not inferred from these field writes.
The current material probe rejects positive reference counts; extend it with observed-allocation bounds before graph runtime capture.
